title: CategoryProductAssociationMessage
description: HCL inbound category–product association (ProductBean or VariantBean). Pub/Sub payload may be one object or an array of objects.

partNumber.description: HCL product part number; maps to CategoryProductAssociation.productId

catEntryTypeId.description: Entry type from HCL; ProductBean or omitted rows sync at product level

promoCatGroupIds.description: Comma-separated HCL category group ids used for Category lookup

partNumber.description: HCL variant part number; maps to CategoryProductAssociation.variantId

catEntryTypeId.description: Entry type from HCL; VariantBean rows sync at variant level

promoCatGroupIds.description: Comma-separated HCL category group ids used for Category lookup
